_firewall_rules_doc: REVERT of Phase 6 (PR #26) — production outage: PR #26 destroyed allow-https while DNS still pointed at gcp-proxy (Phase 4 Caddy migration to oci-analytics had not landed). Restoring allow-https + https-server tag to keep public 443 ingress on gcp-proxy until Phases 4+5 deploy.

firewall_rules.name: allow-https
firewall_rules.description: Allow HTTPS traffic (Caddy + caddy-l4 SNI mux for IMAPS/SMTPS)

firewall_rules.name: allow-wireguard-fallback
firewall_rules.description: WireGuard wg0 fallback — host firewall.nix REDIRECTs udp/443 → udp/51820 for networks blocking 51820

instances.name: gcp-proxy
instances.description: always-on free tier e2-micro (Fedora) — replacement for arch-1

_cloud_run_doc: Cloud Run (serverless containers) fleet registry. One entry per service: runtime, image, env, secret NAMES (Secret Manager; never values), GCS volumes, route, state (live-unmanaged | declared). main.tf creates only managed=true entries; the cloud-c3 Infra page Serverless Cont reads this list.

cloud_run_registry.description: Remote repo proxying ghcr.io so Cloud Run can pull the fleet's GHCR images (amd64 manifests only)

cloud_run_secret_sources._doc: #1686 Secret Manager secret name -> key in the decrypted vault env (CI only). cloud-ship-terraform-deploy-apply.sh builds TF_VAR_cloud_run_secret_values from it; main.tf creates the secret, its version and the runtime-SA secretAccessor grant. A managed service whose secret has no value is held back (output cloud_run_skipped_missing_secrets), never failing the apply.

cloud_run_services.name: agy
cloud_run_services.label: Antigravity (agy)
cloud_run_services.persistence: GCS volume (gcsfuse) on /persist: dotfiles, agy/claude state, workspace, git clones
cloud_run_services.notes: Live today with the four env values set as plain env vars; adopting it = terraform import, then managed=true moves them to Secret Manager refs. min 1 always-on 2 vCPU/2 GiB is outside the free tier.

cloud_run_services.name: capital-stack-finterminal-api
cloud_run_services.label: FinTerminal API
cloud_run_services.persistence: SQLite on a GCS volume with max_instances 1 (single writer). Cloud SQL is the later option if write contention or gcsfuse locking bites.

route.cutover: Caddy keeps the same-origin path and proxies it to the run.app URL with an identity token for roles/run.invoker; APK and web URLs do not change

blockers: the VM image is arm64-only (docker.arch arm64); the amd64 -cloudrun image builds in cloud-run-images.yml and must be pushed (approved dispatch) before the first apply
edge to Cloud Run auth: Caddy must mint a Google ID token (service account) or the app must enforce its bearer; invoker stays IAM-only until then
data copy of the finterm_data volume from oci-apps to the bucket at cutover

cloud_run_services.name: capital-stack-finterminal-web
cloud_run_services.label: FinTerminal Web

route.cutover: the bundle calls the API at the relative path /capital-stack-finterminal-api, so the web and the API stay behind one Caddy origin that proxies both run.app upstreams

blockers: same edge-to-Cloud-Run identity-token step as capital-stack-finterminal-api

cloud_run_services.name: scrappers-api
cloud_run_services.label: Scrappers API

route.auth: two_factor at the edge; /scrappers/health and /scrappers/openapi.json public
route.cutover: Caddy proxies the same path to the run.app URL with an identity token

blockers: the image push (cloud-run-images.yml dispatch push=true) and the Terraform apply are the owner-approved steps
cloud_run_services.notes: #1429 the Cloud Browser's Scrap Tools call POST /download/youtube (yt-dlp + ffmpeg, Dockerfile.cloudrun); timeout 900 s for long downloads. The phone tries the mesh name first and this edge path second.

cloud_run_services.name: languagetool
cloud_run_services.label: LanguageTool
cloud_run_services.persistence: none: rules-only, the oci-apps languagetool_data volume holds no user data (n-grams deferred)

route.auth: IAM invoker; callers send a Google ID token or go through the edge proxy

blockers: callers (mesh name languagetool.mesh.diegonmarcos.com) are repointed only after the edge-to-Cloud-Run identity-token step exists

cloud_run_services.name: cloudy-ai-embeddings-api
cloud_run_services.label: Embeddings API (bge-m3 + reranker)
cloud_run_services.persistence: HF model cache on the instance's own disk (re-downloaded on cold start, about 4.6 GB); a GCS cache volume is optional
blockers: COST RISK: resident about 5 GB needs 8Gi/2 vCPU and a cold start re-downloads 4.6 GB of weights; free-tier vCPU/GiB-seconds go fast under load. Capped at max_instances 1 and concurrency 4

cloud_run_services.name: cloudy-browser-headless
cloud_run_services.label: Headless Browser API

route.auth: bearer BROWSER_TOKEN in the app plus IAM invoker

cloud_run_services.notes: Not the same engine as scrappers-api (Python yt-dlp/instaloader); kept as two entries.

cloud_run_services.name: cloudy-cgc-pub-graph-api
cloud_run_services.label: CGC public graph store (SurrealDB)
cloud_run_services.persistence: SurrealDB on RocksDB: NOT stateless; RocksDB on a gcsfuse volume is unsupported (no POSIX locks, random writes)
cloud_run_services.decision: 2026-11-12 architect: stays on oci-apps (RocksDB is unfit for a gcsfuse volume). Declared for the registry only; never managed.
